Also present: .

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55652  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee Meeting of

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  25-55653  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the draft 2025 Homeless
  Services Advisory Committee (HSAC) Policy Recommendation to the Mayor and
  City Council.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4 Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

  Page 1 of 3
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, JULY 7, 2025
  3861 WORSHAM AVENUE LONG BEACH, CA 90808
  WORSHAM CONFERENCE ROOM, 4:00 PM

  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 0 None

  • Members of the committee reviewed the 2024 draft policy recommendations,
  including the comments submitted by member Julie Lie. The subcommittee
  agreed to move the final draft forward for a vote at the Homeless Services
  Advisory Committee (HSAC) meeting scheduled for August 6, 2025.
  • In addition, the committee will begin preparations to ensure the Annual
  Report is completed and submitted by June 30, 2026.

3.  25-55654  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion of the proposed 2025 state
  legislation addressing homelessness, including but not limited to Senate Bill 634.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Members of the subcommittee discussed Senate Bill 634, which prohibits the
  detention or imprisonment of an individual based solely on their actual or
  perceived protected characteristics.
  • The subcommittee expressed interest in obtaining more information about
  the City’s position on this bill and how it aligns with local policies and
  practices.
  • A member of the public provided a comment expressing a desire for
  subcommittee members to be more informed about the City’s official position
  on key issues. They also encouraged the subcommittee to use its meetings
  to engage in more discussion about future plans and strategic direction.

4.  25-55655  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion of future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  Page 2 of 3
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, JULY 7, 2025
  3861 WORSHAM AVENUE LONG BEACH, CA 90808
  WORSHAM CONFERENCE ROOM, 4:00 PM

  Absent:  0 None

  • The subcommittee members would like to hear regarding the following items:
  o What programs within homeless services are currently demonstrating
  the most success? Are we conducting formal program audits to
  assess their impact, and which initiatives appear most promising as
  we look ahead?
  o With the recent increase in vehicular homelessness indicated in the
  latest Point-in-Time (PIT) count, what strategies are in place—or
  being developed—to address this growing issue?
  o What approaches, and engagement methods are our outreach teams
  using when connecting with individuals experiencing homelessness?
  How are these strategies tailored to meet diverse needs?
  • A member of the public commented that existing programs should undergo
  evaluations to determine their effectiveness and ensure they are achieving
  intended outcomes.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • No announcements.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Sarah Bedy, adjourns the meeting at 4:59 p.m.
